wholePhysicalScope: OSM way 391276941 controls the existing building and verandah footprint at the recorded street address. The Canadian Register identifies the street facade, later wraparound extension and slope.
lodDetails: Four levels preserve the historic central gable, Palladian balcony, verandah and exposed downhill basement.
limitations: Draft exterior: approximate photographic proportions and simplified ornament. It is not a survey, photogrammetric reconstruction or approved current geographic replacement.
The original ca. 1880 municipal archive photograph sets the shapes of the steep front gable, balcony, porch trim and chimneys. The official register describes the exposed rear basement and main roof.
Terrain sampling/contact, geographic alignment and site activation remain pending. Runtime LODs are produced by the registered after-import pipeline and require visual review.
Reference photos remain in the local Qualla corpus; only provenance, paths and hashes are retained here.
